title: Microsoft Just Launched Agent 365 With Claude Inside
description:
Microsoft just launched Agent 365. And Claude is one of the AI models running it. 

This is a huge moment because it's the first time Microsoft is using Anthropic's models alongside GPT and their own, picking which one to use based on the task. 

For autonomous work across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive, and SharePoint, Claude is the model they trust. 

Microsoft just validated that Claude is the most capable AI for real professional work.
channel_name: Brock Mesarich | AI for Non Techies
